title: raid-constant.json
description: Every magnitude an engagement is made of — the portal's stability and its decay, the battlefield and its terrain, the per-side caps, the derived combatant statistics, the objective values and the victory threshold. As data rather than as literals in the rules path, for the reason god-constant.json is: a retune is a content change a sweep can turn, and it sits inside contentRevision, so two universes cannot disagree about how long a portal holds while agreeing they may fight. The *set* of ids is structural — the rules read each by name and the loader rejects a set missing one or carrying an unknown one. Every *value* is an untuned placeholder awaiting the balance harness.
